memberships.description: Extract every purchasable membership tier on the source page separately, including tiers whose benefits require image reading. Never borrow a fee or entitlement from another tier.

benefits.description: Quote every source-supported entitlement and restriction for this plan as a complete statement: monthly credits, included services and selection limits, gifts and frequency, discounts, minimum term, rollover, cancellation, exclusions and eligibility. Preserve quantities, prices and conditions together. Include shared terms only where the source explicitly applies them to this plan. Do not limit extraction to discount bullets. Unknown or unreadable image benefits must be null; never invent missing text or use an empty array for an unreadable plan.

source_claims.description: Independent inventory of every verbatim entitlement or restriction for this tier from the source, including credits, included services, gifts, discounts, frequency, term, rollover, cancellation and exclusions. Do not copy from the benefits output; inventory directly from the page. Empty only when the page explicitly shows no entitlements.
